map.壁纸用量计算器，按墙面尺寸与壁纸幅宽、幅长、损耗率求所需卷数与幅数，辅助装修贴壁: The wallpaper quantity calculator derives the rolls and drops needed from wall dimensions, wallpaper width/length and waste rate, helping with material preparation and budgeting.
map.贴壁纸幅数 = 墙面总长 ÷ 幅宽: Wallpaper drops = total wall length ÷ drop width
map.整墙贴壁纸：输入墙宽高与壁纸幅宽/幅长，按「墙高÷幅长向上取整×墙宽÷幅宽」得幅: Full-wall wallpaper: enter wall width/height and wallpaper width/length, compute drops as 'ceil(wall height ÷ drop length) × (wall width ÷ drop width)', then convert to rolls.
map.对花壁纸：有循环花距需每幅对齐，额外加花距损耗，卷数上浮。: Pattern-matched wallpaper: with a repeating pattern each drop must align, adding pattern waste and pushing the roll count up.
map.多墙合计：逐墙算后汇总，预留 1–2 卷同批次补货避免色差。: Multiple walls: compute each wall and total up, reserving 1–2 extra rolls of the same batch to avoid colour mismatch.
map.：示例：墙宽 3.6m、高 2.7m，壁纸幅宽 0.53m、幅长 10m，损耗:
: Example: wall width 3.6 m, height 2.7 m, wallpaper width 0.53 m, length 10 m, waste 5%.
• Each drop yields 10÷2.7 ≈ 3 drops (rounded down) → 3 drops per roll
• Horizontal drops ≈ 3.6÷0.53 ≈ 7 → needs 7÷3 ≈ 3 rolls (rounded up)
• Including waste, 3–4 rolls of the same batch are advised
map.单卷壁纸的可用长度（常见 10m/卷），决定每卷能裁几幅。: The usable length per roll of wallpaper (commonly 10 m/roll), which determines how many drops each roll yields.
map.有花距的壁纸每幅对齐花型会浪费一段，按花距加损耗，通常卷数上浮 1 卷。: With patterned wallpaper, aligning each drop wastes a length equal to the pattern repeat, so add that waste; typically the roll count goes up by one.
map.买少了能补同色吗？: Can I buy more later and match the color?
map.不同批次壁纸易有色差，建议一次买足并多备 1–2 卷，宁可多不退。: Different batches of wallpaper often differ in color, so buy enough at once and keep 1–2 spare rolls—better to have extra than to return them.
